title: Edit: revolve 180° instead of 360°
prompt: Make this a half collar: revolve it 180° instead of all the way round, so I can print two halves and clamp them around the pipe. Don't change the profile.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Half the full collar: π·2882.4/2 ≈ 4527.7 mm³ ±0.1%
A half ring: 44 mm across the flange, 22 mm deep, 15 mm tall
Two new flat faces where the ring is cut (3 + 2 planar faces)
The same three cylindrical faces (bore, outside, flange rim), now half cylinders
Exactly one feature changed: the revolve's angle

notes: Full collar π·[(22² − 12.8²)·3 + (18² − 12.8²)·12] = π·2882.4. A symmetric ±90° revolve is an equally good half: every check is orientation-independent.
